changeSet.author: oriso

rollback.sql: -- Guard: refuse (duplicate-key error) while a request references a seeded neutral row. -- Deleting it would orphan that request; recover by rolling forward instead. INSERT INTO case_handover_reason_policy (code, label, policy_authority) SELECT p.code, 'rollback blocked: referenced by case_handover_request', 'rollback-guard' FROM case_handover_reason_policy p WHERE p.seeded_by_neutral_reasons = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM case_handover_request r WHERE r.reason_code = p.code); UPDATE case_handover_reason_policy SET enabled = 1 WHERE retired_by_neutral_reasons = 1; -- Only rows this changeset inserted; pre-existing neutral rows stay. DELETE FROM case_handover_reason_policy WHERE seeded_by_neutral_reasons = 1;
